answer.answer: PMJDY provides universal banking services including basic savings bank accounts, access to credit, remittances, insurance, and pension to unbanked citizens [E01]. The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY), another flagship scheme from the Ministry of Finance, finances income-generating micro-enterprises by facilitating micro credit/loans up to Rs. 20 lakhs to non-farm sector micro and small entities [E02].
